title: The Glazier
subtitle: A dependency written against an alias
description: The dependency here is written as `the_nameless_stall`, which is not any quest's id — it is the stall's alias. A second name resolves everywhere a first one does, which is what makes a rename safe.
`hideDetailsUntilStartable` withholds the task and reward details until the quest can be started. The prerequisites stay: they are what tells the reader how to unlock it.
